text:
Nina: Hey team  quick morning thing tomorrow? 6:30am lobby meet. Options: 25m guided stretch + 20m easy run, OR a straight 5k tempo. Also optional quick boulder at 7:40 for anyone who wants to climb after. Who's in? :sunrise:

Omar: In for the stretch+run combo. Need something gentle after yesterday's deadlifts. :sweat_smile:

Priya: 5k tempo for me. Can't do climbing afterwards but can help spot/register people.

Ben: Stretch+run. I can bring a spare mat and a small headlamp. Also down for the boulder if we keep it casual. :mountain:

Nina: Awesome. React with :person_in_lotus_position: for stretch+run, :runner: for 5k, :climber: if you definitely want climbing after. I'll grab an instructor if we get 4+ for guided stretch (HR covers one class a month FYI).

Omar: :person_in_lotus_position: (and yes to instructor if available)

Priya: :runner:

Ben: :person_in_lotus_position: :climber:

Nina: Cool — looks like guided split is winning. I'll book the small huddle room for 6:25 (for mats/warmup) and post the Strava link after. Meet back in lobby 7:20 to head to the wall.

Priya: If anyone needs shoe borrow or chalk, DM me. I'm 8.5 EUR. (edited)

Omar: Can anyone pick me up a coffee afterwards? I'll repay in donut-equivalent. :coffee:

Ben: I'll bring the extra mat and a couple of climbing shoes (7.5-9). DM sizes. Also I'm happy to timer intervals for the run.

wellness-bot: Reminder: Lobby doors unlock at 6:20. Please sign the visitor log if you bring guests. (automated)

Nina: Final plan: 6:30 guided stretch (20-25m) -> 6:55 quick run loop (2.5-4k depending on group) -> optional boulder 7:40. Ping me if you need gear. See you all sunrise! :sparkles:

Priya: See you! Donuts mentioned? I'm in. :doughnut:
